messages:
Jia: Quick sync — we need to lock launch criteria for the Customer Onramp MVP by EOW Fri. Major deps: runtime prefix/KV caching + adaptive batching, infra quota/burst + canary routing, security SSO review. Who can own what and what can we cut if needed?

Omar: I can take runtime caching + batching. Rough estimate: ~3 weeks at 0.5 FTE to get stable KV prefix cache + tuning. If we cut scope we should disable long-context/extended-history in MVP.

Leah: Infra note — we can spin up burst GPU pool but need ~2 week lead to provision and entitlement work. For canary routing + region splits there's infra tickets to create; estimate 10 business days with a dedicated infra engineer.

Sameer: Security: full SSO + SCIM integration and pen testing is >6 weeks. I can do a high-level risk assessment in ~4 days and propose mitigations. Suggest token-based API + strict audit logging for MVP as a fallback.

Samir: Sales/customers will push for SSO. Token-only might be ok for early adopters but we need clear comms. Any chance we ship SSO as a pilot to 1 customer?

Jia: Proposal: cut SSO from the MVP slice; require audit logs + allowlist and an "SSO pilot" program (invite-only) post-launch. Draft launch gates: 1) p99 latency <= 250ms on canary, 2) no data leakage, 3) infra capacity validated, 4) security either sign-off SSO or explicit waiver. Thoughts?

Omar: Agree with the cut. We'll do KV prefix cache + adaptive batching + fallback model for capacity spikes. Minimal rollout config I propose: 

```
rollout:
  stage: canary
  percent: 10
  fallback: model-small
  metrics:
    latency_p99: 250
    error_rate: 0.5
```

Omar: I'll open PRs for the cache + batching work — target PR by Tue. I need a backend reviewer and infra ticket to validate routing. @Leah can you review the routing hook?

Leah: Yep — I'll create infra ticket for routing policy + capacity delta and assign an infra engineer. ETA for ticket is Thu, implementation estimate 10 business days after assignment. Adding @Nora as reviewer.

Sameer: For audit logs: we need schema + retention window. Security asks we hash user IDs in logs and store raw identifiers only behind KMS for 90 days. I'll produce a short SSO risk memo + audit schema by Wed. Also want an opt-in flag for SSO pilot users in the canary config.

Samir: I'll draft the customer comms explaining SSO pilot + token-based MVP and include timelines. Note: Sales flagged 2 enterprise deals that expect SSO at GA — I'll loop legal & sales and get a formal risk note.

Jia: Action items (summary):
- Omar: PR for KV cache + batching by Tue (owner: Omar)
- Leah: infra ticket + capacity plan by Thu (owner: Leah)
- Sameer: SSO risk memo + audit log schema by Wed (owner: Sameer)
- Samir: customer comms draft & sales escalation by Thu (owner: Samir)
We keep SSO out of MVP but require clear waiver for any customer that needs it at launch.

Omar: ack, will ping @Leah on the PR for routing bits. Need one backend reviewer for the cache PR — @Leah or @Nora? :thumbsup:

Leah: I can review the routing section. Assign to @Nora for infra review.

Samir: Drafting comms now; will share in #customer-success for feedback.

Jia: I'll update the roadmap doc (link: https://redwood.internal/roadmap/onramp) and add the launch gates. Also setting a quick sync tomorrow 09:30 to confirm owners.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Heads up — release freeze starts Fri 09:00 UTC (reminder).

Sameer: Quick flag: if infra can't meet canary capacity we need rollback plan + degraded routing (rate-limit heavier customers). I'll add that to the memo.

Jia: Good call. Add rollback and a degraded mode that forces smaller model and lower concurrency. Final ask: please update your tickets with expected FTEs so PM can adjust resourcing.

Omar: Will do.

Leah: Will do.

Samir: Will post comms by EOD Thu. :white_check_mark:

Jia: Thanks everyone — this is helpful. I'll capture notes + post follow-up after tomorrow's sync. :sparkles:
